units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 121b:12">B. Bath. 121ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>לשבטים … לקרקף גברי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לקרקפא דג׳</he>) was the land divided by tribes (each tribe getting an equal share) or by the heads of men? <cite ref="Shabbat 67a:9">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> (in an incantation) <he>אקרקף דארי וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אקרקפי</he>, read: <he>אקַרְקְפֵיה</he>) on the head of a lion, and on the nostrils &c.
B. Bath. 55ᵃ אקרקף וכ׳ (Ar. אקרקפא; Rashb. אקרקפתא), v. כַּרְגָּא; a. e.—Fem. form קַרְקַפְתָּא.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:10">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ דלא מנח תפלין</he> (Tosaf. <he>מנחא</he>) the head (of him) that puts no T’fillin on. B. Bath. l. c., v. supra.
